summary: §109's framing, CRC scope, canonical payload, monotonic generations, state transitions, lock order, and pre-open checks are broadly coherent with §§42/108. One P1 contradiction blocks approval: startup is required to reject any unacknowledged frame, but acknowledgment is the writer's Sync outcome and is not encoded in the append-only frame. A complete frame can remain visible after Sync reports failure, so restart cannot distinguish it from a successfully synced frame. Define recovery from observable evidence or add a separately justified durable acknowledgment protocol.

findings.title: Catalog replay cannot distinguish a complete unacknowledged frame after Sync error

findings.evidence: The frame stores canonical payload, lengths, CRC and trailer but no Sync acknowledgment fact. Append may write a complete frame and then receive a Sync error. On restart the same complete CRC-valid bytes are replayed whether Sync previously succeeded or failed. A prior process return value is not observable from the catalog file.
findings.risk: The implementation cannot satisfy the stated requirement to load only acknowledged append boundaries and globally reject complete-but-unacknowledged frames. It must either make an arbitrary choice or add an unstated external mechanism.
findings.required_action: Specify recovery solely from restart-observable state, e.g. validate the complete chain and conservatively recheck underlying DB/sidecar facts for state transitions, while rejecting partial/invalid frames; or design a separate durable acknowledgment mechanism with a complete crash protocol. Remove the claim that the present frame can reveal a past Sync error.

control_dispositions.catalog_trust_model: coherent with §42: ACL/verified-handle trust boundary, CRC is not authentication, trusted-account compromise excluded
control_dispositions.wire_format: deterministic and bounded; strict canonical payload, frame checks, contiguous generations and tombstones
control_dispositions.state_machine: consistent with durable open_recovery_required, pending_unknown and quarantine semantics in §108
control_dispositions.lock_order: case lifecycle lock then global catalog lock; catalog holders do not wait for case locks; no cycle apparent
control_dispositions.replay_and_sync_ack: unimplementable distinction: complete frame does not reveal whether prior Sync returned success
control_dispositions.resource_limits: explicit global fail-closed exhaustion; compaction requires a separately reviewed protocol
control_dispositions.implementation_status: catalog/supervisor implementation explicitly not claimed to exist; verified-open, locking, durability and ACL remain implementation gates

remaining_conditions: Resolve the unobservable acknowledged/unacknowledged frame requirement with an implementable restart rule or separate durable acknowledgment protocol.
Implement and validate supervisor/catalog pre-open authorization, global lock, state transitions, full-chain parsing and platform durability/ACL controls.
limitations: No tests or runtime validation were performed.
No implementation, OS lock, filesystem Sync behavior, process restart, or fault injection was examined.
This report assesses the written protocol only and does not claim implementation readiness.
